title: Productivity evidence ladder
question: Does the protocol actually improve the work, and how do we know?
principle: Benefit is measured, never assumed. A perfectly assured protocol starts at NO_IMPACT_EVIDENCE and stays there until an evaluation moves it. The negative outcomes are findings, not low rungs: a protocol found to give no clear gain, or to cause harm, has been evaluated more thoroughly than one with no evidence at all.

promotion.reason: Candidate v0.2 records evidence profiles but requires a separate, independently reviewed promotion artifact before any positive state can be issued. Setting, study stage, identification and review status are separate dimensions.

states.label: No impact evidence
states.meaning: No evaluation of benefit has been run. This says nothing about whether the protocol helps, harms, or is even usable. Usability observations, assurance checks, governance and incident records remain separate from this evidence state.
states.established_by: Default for any protocol before evaluation.

states.label: Benchmark signal
states.meaning: It improves outcomes on an artificial or curated task set.
states.established_by: A benchmark-design eval showing improvement on the agent-with-protocol arm versus agent-without-protocol.

states.label: Controlled user signal
states.meaning: A preregistered primary outcome shows a context-bound net improvement in a controlled-user comparison, with uncertainty, missingness, and all frozen guardrails reported.
states.established_by: An independently reviewed controlled-user artifact with an adequate design, complete participant flow, frozen task allocation, uncertainty, missingness sensitivity, and no blocking quality, cost, burden, accessibility, error, or safety regression.

states.label: Field signal
states.meaning: A real organisation or user group records a measured beneficial association in ordinary use.
states.established_by: An organisational-field report with prospective measurement, denominators, missingness, costs, guardrails, and transfer limits. FIELD_SIGNAL alone does not attribute the change to the protocol.

states.label: Causal effect supported
states.meaning: A defensible identification strategy supports a context-bound attributable net productivity effect.
states.established_by: A confirmatory randomized or defensible quasi-experimental study in a controlled-user or organisational-field setting, measuring a human/work outcome, with independent review of identification, uncertainty, missingness sensitivity, guardrails, and the licensed transfer boundary. A model-only benchmark is capped at BENCHMARK_SIGNAL. This is the claim the Policy Identification Observatory would audit.

states.label: No clear gain
states.meaning: Testing found no worthwhile net improvement.
states.established_by: An eval whose vector shows no dimension improved enough to matter, or gains offset by costs. Retained, not hidden.

states.label: Harm or regression found
states.meaning: It reduced quality, raised burden, or created unacceptable risk.
states.established_by: An eval showing a material regression on any dimension, or any safety event. Blocks FIELD_READY on the assurance ladder until resolved.
